gaps.sentence: Not since the winter of 1963 ___ temperatures dropped so low.
gaps.explanation: 'Not since 1963 have temperatures dropped …' — the only time from then until now.

gaps.sentence: Only when the last vote had been counted ___ the returning officer speak.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when' at the front forces question order: did the returning officer speak.

gaps.sentence: Only when she apologised ___ he agree to meet again.
gaps.explanation: Only when she apologised did he agree — inversion.

gaps.sentence: Seldom have I been so ___ by a performance.
gaps.explanation: 'moved' — the audience was emotionally affected; inversion with have been.

gaps.sentence: Not until the following morning ___ the damage reported to the police.
gaps.explanation: 'Not until + time' triggers inversion: 'was the damage reported'.

gaps.sentence: ___ I richer, I would travel the world.
gaps.explanation: Were I richer = If I were richer — formal inversion.

gaps.sentence: At no time ___ the crew aware of the danger.
gaps.explanation: 'At no time was the crew aware' — inverted past simple of be.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the bridge unsafe, but it was also far too narrow.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only was the bridge unsafe' — inverted past simple of be.
